messages:
alice: Customer on prod sees garbled streaming output — multiple top-level JSON objects getting merged or truncated when going through our ALB + nginx chain. Example payload returned to client: `{"id":1,"msg":"ok"}{"id":2,"msg":"slow"}` (should be two separate objects). Go SDK v0.9.8. Trace: rlog=trace-9b7c

devon: Can you paste repro steps + raw bytes? is this only behind the proxy or also direct to hosted API?

alice: Repro is easy: customer hits our /v1/stream endpoint via ALB -> nginx. Direct to hosted API shows correct chunking. They shared a curl capture and a tiny go consumer:```go
// simplified reader
resp, _ := client.Stream(ctx, req)
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
  fmt.Println(scanner.Text())
}
// stderr: sometimes prints two objects concatenated
```

ben: Two things to check: 1) bufio.Scanner default token max 64k -> token too long errors; 2) proxies (ALB/nginx) can coalesce chunked frames or buffer small chunks into larger writes which can cause scanner rebuffering logic to combine boundaries. Which exact go-sdk version? you said v0.9.8; we shipped a streaming scanner tweak in v0.10.x that changes split behavior for top-level JSON.

carol: ALB + nginx common culprit: nginx proxy_buffering can merge chunked frames. Ask customer to try `proxy_buffering off;` or add `X-Accel-Buffering: no` from upstream to disable buffering. ALB also sometimes switches HTTP/2->HTTP/1.1 which changes how chunks are emitted.

alice: Customer tried disabling gzip and toggling keepalive; partial improvement. I also captured raw payload (hex): `7b226964223a312c226d7367223a226f6b227d7b226964223a322c...` which decodes to the merged `}{` boundary.

devon: Can the SDK avoid returning merged tokens? If scanner rebuffer logic merges two consecutive JSON objects across internal buffers, that explains the symptom.

ben: Confirmed: older scanner split func did not always emit split at `}{` boundaries if a rebuffer happened. Workaround for customers: read by bytes and unmarshal streaming JSON decoder (json.Decoder with UseNumber) instead of Scanner, or upgrade to go-sdk >= v0.10.3 which includes our partial fix. Also recommended: set `Connection: keep-alive` and disable proxy buffering.

alice: Minimal curl repro to try locally (forces small chunks):
```bash
# simulate small chunked writes from a toy server
python3 -c "import sys,time; sys.stdout.write('{\"id\":1}\n'); sys.stdout.flush(); time.sleep(0.2); sys.stdout.write('{\"id\":2}\n'); sys.stdout.flush()"
# then proxy through nginx and curl -N
```

support-bot: Ticket-T12345 attached to thread; priority P2. If customer cannot upgrade, escalate to eng-runtime.

ben: I'll open a PR to make the scanner split function conservative around top-level object boundaries and add a test for `}{` across buffer edges. Plan: release v0.10.4 with patch + changelog entry. If urgent, provide a patch release to the customer.

carol: Also recommend capture of tcpdump + raw bytes for us to verify ALB coalescing behavior before patch.

alice: I'll send customer the workaround (disable proxy buffering, upgrade or switch to json.Decoder) and ask for tcpdump. Will re-open if they still see it. :thumbsup:

ben: noted. I'll post PR link when ready. :eyes:
